comment: Surveyed elevations of existing overhead conductors and building elevation drawings showing clearance dimensions are required to verify 7'6" sky-to-ground clearance is maintained from conductors to building faces and projections.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings (Buildings 1-8) on site

comment: Plans must specify whether existing overhead lines are distribution primary/neutral conductors, and provide 15-foot radial clearance dimensions from outside conductor to all customer facilities in plan and section views.
applicableAreas: All customer facilities (buildings 1-8, parking, infrastructure) relative to OHE line on southern boundary

comment: Building elevation sheets with surveyed overhead conductor elevations and dimension annotations showing clearances from conductors to all building projections (roofs, parapets, overhangs, decks, patios) must be provided.
applicableAreas: Building roofs, parapets, overhangs, and projections on Buildings 1-8

comment: If any elevated walkways, stairs, or platforms are proposed, provide section views with dimension annotations showing 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor.
applicableAreas: Elevated walkways, stairs, platforms near OHE line if any are proposed

comment: Austin Energy utility plan showing exact location of overhead facilities in adjacent ROW with clearance dimensions from buildings must be provided.
applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 2, and other structures near Valley View Road ROW

comment: Building elevation sheets prepared by registered surveyor must include surveyed elevations and locations of existing overhead conductors with dimension annotations showing clearances to building components.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings (Buildings 1-8)

comment: Provide enlarged plan details and section views with dimension lines extending from outside conductor to outermost edges of all buildings and building projections, demonstrating required clearance envelopes are maintained.
applicableAreas: All buildings and projections relative to OHE line on southern boundary

comment: Plan must include dimension annotations showing 7.5-foot horizontal clearance from outside conductor to fence face, measured from conductor location not from pole centerline.
applicableAreas: Privacy fences along southern property boundary near OHE line

comment: Site plan must clearly identify existing utility pole locations and provide dimension annotations showing minimum 10-foot clearance from fence posts to pole centerlines.
applicableAreas: Fence posts relative to utility poles at property corners

comment: If retaining walls are located near overhead electric lines, provide section views with dimension annotations showing 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from outside conductor to wall face.
applicableAreas: Retaining walls around biofiltration pond if located near overhead lines

comment: Section views for retaining walls near any overhead electric lines must include dimension annotations showing clearance from outside conductor to wall face.
applicableAreas: Retaining walls around biofiltration detention pond

comment: Registered surveyor mid-span clearance data must be provided showing vertical clearance from lowest point of overhead facilities (including all conductors and attachments) to finished driveway grades. Section views must show 16-foot clearance for parking without truck traffic or 18-foot for areas with truck traffic.
applicableAreas: Driveways and parking areas if located beneath or adjacent to OHE line

comment: Site plan must clearly show the location of all existing utility poles and provide dimension annotations indicating clearance from driveway edges. If any poles are within 30 feet of driveway edge, relocation plans must be noted.
applicableAreas: Utility poles at property boundaries relative to proposed driveways

comment: All clearance dimension annotations must explicitly originate at the outside conductor location, not at the utility pole centerline or pole face. Dimension lines and callouts must clearly show measurement origin point (e.g., '15'-0" from outside conductor').
applicableAreas: All clearance dimensions relative to overhead electric infrastructure

comment: Enlarged plan details must show existing power pole locations at property ends and document that proposed sidewalk alignments maintain adequate clearance from pole structures, or note if poles are to be relocated.
applicableAreas: Sidewalks along Valley View Road frontage at property ends

comment: Plans must include Austin Energy easement exhibit showing electric easement boundaries with notes confirming no buildings or permanent structures are proposed under or over overhead distribution facilities, and that items within easement boundaries maintain minimum 7.5-foot clearance from outside conductor.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings (1-8) and site features relative to OHE line and electric easement

comment: Utility plan must show locations of overhead electric service-drop lines with dimension annotations verifying 7.5-foot clearance from service drop conductors to water meter locations.
applicableAreas: Water meter locations relative to overhead electric service drops

comment: Utility plan must include dimension annotations showing clearance distances from water line routing to all overhead electric poles and conductors.
applicableAreas: Water line routing relative to overhead distribution infrastructure

comment: Registered surveyor must provide documented mid-span clearance measurements for existing overhead facilities showing vertical distance from lowest point of conductors and attachments to highest proposed site features (building roofs, HVAC equipment, etc.) to demonstrate code-required clearances are maintained.
applicableAreas: All site features with vertical extent (buildings, parking structures, etc.)

comment: Photometric plan or enlarged lighting detail must show locations of all decorative light fixtures near overhead electric lines with dimension annotations verifying clearance requirements are met (7.5-foot sky-to-ground, 15-foot radial), or notes indicating fixtures are relocated away from lines.
applicableAreas: Decorative lighting fixtures if located near overhead electric line

comment: Plant schedule must specify which tree species are utility-compatible per ECM Appendix F for planting within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors. Tree species must be marked or noted as 'UC' (Utility Compatible, generally ≤20' mature height). Plan must include dimension annotations showing lateral distance (horizontal) from each tree location to the overhead conductor and note species compliance with utility compatibility requirement.
applicableAreas: Trees within 10 lateral feet of OHE line on southern boundary

comment: Enlarged meter detail views must show 30-inch front width, 36-inch front depth, and 6.5-foot headroom clearances around each meter location, confirming no site features, fences, walls, vegetation, or building projections obstruct access.
applicableAreas: Electrical meter locations throughout site

comment: Site plan must clearly identify existing down guy wire anchor locations and document resolution of any conflicts with proposed accessible routes and driveways through pole relocation or conversion to self-supporting poles, or provide plan notes confirming no conflicts exist.
applicableAreas: Down guy anchor locations relative to proposed accessible routes and driveways

comment: Easement exhibit and plat must identify and show 10-foot-wide down guy anchor easements extending minimum 5 feet past ground entry point for each down guy support cable on property.
applicableAreas: Down guy anchor points at property corners

comment: Electrical design plan must specify transformer types (pole-mounted or pad-mounted) and provide section views with dimension annotations showing vertical clearance from overhead line conductors to top of transformer equipment, verifying 7.5-foot minimum clearance.
applicableAreas: Proposed transformer locations if located beneath overhead lines

comment: Construction logistics plan or site phasing plan must document staging area boundaries, crane swing radius zones, equipment laydown areas, and work platforms with dimension annotations verifying 10-foot radial clearance from all overhead electric lines. Construction management notes must address overhead line safety during all phases.
applicableAreas: Construction staging areas, equipment operation zones, work platforms

comment: Add note to cover sheet or general notes: 'Owner/contractor shall notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before beginning any construction activities or operations near overhead electric lines. Contact Austin Energy at [number] per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003.'
applicableAreas: Cover sheet or general notes

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary near overhead electric line
